limitations: Official manual establishesUTC for this post2014 subdaily query. Eight24:00 rows carry next-day calendar labels and require explicit boundary interpretation before normalization.

clock_convention_documented: UTC for hourly/subdaily records after2014-04-01, per official SiAR user manual; does not resolve24:00 calendar-boundary formatting.
utc_timestamp_policy: Raw source labels retained; all observed_at_utc and available_at_utc fields remain null pending interval/boundary review. Do not add a day blindly to date+24:00.
